verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a notarization, translation and incorporation service. An in-product AI insights feature is a fair question for a SaaS like this, but the evidence documents none. The only AI mention is AI-powered detection of signature and location/date fields during notarization. That is an adjacent automation feature, not AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
